   pure $ either errorResult successResult result

       "unspecified" -> pure KindUnspecified
       "original_plan" -> pure KindOriginalPlan
       "wave_plan" -> pure KindWavePlan
       "spawned_child" -> pure KindSpawnedChild
       "child_handoff" -> pure KindChildHandoff
       "blocker" -> pure KindBlocker

       "ci_result" -> pure KindCiResult
       "next_action" -> pure KindNextAction
       "human_clarification" -> pure KindHumanClarification
       "session_summary" -> pure KindSessionSummary
       other -> fail $ "Unknown memory kind: " <> T.unpack other

findings.from:
if mergeSuccess then
    do let eventPayload
             = BSL.toStrict
                 $ Aeson.encode
                     $ object
                         ["pr_number" .= mprPrNumber args, "success" .= True,
                          "head_sha" .= headShaValue, "head_sha_finding" .= headShaFinding]
       void
         $ suspendEffect_
             @LogEmitEvent
             (Log.EmitEventRequest
                {Log.emitEventRequestEventType = "pr.merged",
                 Log.emitEventRequestPayload = eventPayload,
                 Log.emitEventRequestTimestamp = 0})
       cleanupMergedAgent branchName
else
    pure ()
findings.to:
when mergeSuccess
  $ do let eventPayload
             = BSL.toStrict
                 $ Aeson.encode
                     $ object
                         ["pr_number" .= mprPrNumber args, "success" .= True,
                          "head_sha" .= headShaValue, "head_sha_finding" .= headShaFinding]
       void
         $ suspendEffect_
             @LogEmitEvent
             (Log.EmitEventRequest
                {Log.emitEventRequestEventType = "pr.merged",
                 Log.emitEventRequestPayload = eventPayload,
                 Log.emitEventRequestTimestamp = 0})
       cleanupMergedAgent branchName

  = either
      (\ err -> detail <> "; local restore failed: " <> err)
      (const detail) recovered
